description: This PHP source file defines the OEmbedForm class, a Drupal form class for creating media entities from oEmbed URLs within the media_library module. It includes methods for constructing the form, validating URLs, and handling form submission, utilizing services like URL resolver and resource fetcher.

classes.name: OEmbedForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for creating media entities from oEmbed URLs within the media_library module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with necessary services like URL resolver and resource fetcher.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form class using dependency injection container.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique form ID for this form.

methods.name: getMediaType
methods.description: Retrieves the media type, ensuring it uses an oEmbed source plugin.

methods.name: buildInputElement
methods.description: Builds the form elements for URL input and submit button.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates the entered URL by resolving and fetching the resource, setting an error if invalid.

methods.name: addButtonSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to process the input URL.
